supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: productcatalogservice_latency-90 z=944.51 (4722.6%); productcatalogservice_latency-50 z=520.78 (2603.9%); recommendationservice_latency-90 z=455.66 (2278.3%); recommendationservice_latency-50 z=424.71 (2123.5%)
traces for productcatalogservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.01->0.02ms (1.25x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 2.42->202.98ms (83.7x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency deviation (p90 z=455.66) is about half of productcatalogservice's (p90 z=944.51) per E1. Callers of productcatalogservice see 83.7x latency per E2, so recommendationservice's rise looks propagated from the catalog it depends on.

Its own span self-time barely moved (0.01->0.02ms) while inbound caller-observed latency rose 2.42->202.98ms (E2). The time is spent outside its own computation, which points to network delay. No CPU metric appears among the top deviations in E1.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the injected network delay (e.g., tc netem rules or a delay fault) on productcatalogservice's network interface or sidecar. Confirm that caller-observed latency returns to the ~2.4ms baseline.
